# Psalm 121 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song for-the-ascents. I-lift my-eyes to the-mountains; from-where will-come my-help?

**2** My-help from YHWH, maker-of heaven and-earth.

**3** Not he-will-allow to-slip your-foot; not will-slumber your-keeper.

**4** Behold not will-slumber and-not will-sleep the-keeper-of Israel.

**5** YHWH your-keeper; YHWH your-shade at-hand-of your-right.

**6** By-day the-sun not will-strike-you, and-the-moon by-night.

**7** YHWH will-keep-you from-all evil; he-will-keep your-soul.

**8** YHWH will-keep your-going-out and-your-coming-in, from-now and-to forever.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **121:1-2**: The question-answer format: 'From-where?' answered by 'From YHWH' — the mountains may evoke pagan high places, but help comes from the Creator, not creation.

- **121:3-8**: Shamar ('keep/guard') appears six times — the psalm is saturated with the concept of divine protection.

— EMET
